replies.body:
Updated the upper PR and merged selector rename `b91c2c5a` without rewriting history; `dc46313f` remains on the first-parent chain. Commit: `626daa13`. The saved PR body still has the old property and overbroad Flow wording. I could not edit it: the available GitHub tools are read-only for PR bodies, and browser OAuth was unavailable. Suggested replacement:

Disable `@WithSpan` on Kotlin suspend functions—including suspend functions returning `Flow`—by default for 3.0. Tail-optimized calls can resume application code on the wrong thread, breaking dispatcher confinement and thread-bound state such as Spring transactions. See #20744.

To opt in despite this unresolved risk:
```properties
otel.instrumentation.kotlinx-coroutines-suspend-annotations.enabled=true
```

Coroutine context propagation and non-suspend `@WithSpan` functions, including those returning `Flow`, remain unaffected; their Flow spans end when collection completes.

Consolidated the JVM opt-in into the shared `withType<Test>().configureEach` block, excluding `testDisabled`. Formatter, ordinary tests, version13Test, and testDisabled pass; verified only test and version13Test receive the opt-in. Commit: `67fe0599`.
